title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Measure the efficiency of a real kettle and add it to the notes
body:
## Problem
The models assume an efficiency of 0.85 for the heater; nobody has compared it with a real kettle.

## Context
Session 2 asks learners to time a kettle. A table of real measurements would show how far the model is from reality.

## Expected outcome
A short table (volume, label power, time to boil, computed efficiency) added to the Session 2 experiment notes, with the method described.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three measurements with units
- [ ] Computed efficiency for each
- [ ] A sentence on sources of error

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and green markers for safe and unsafe states; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or marker shape that works for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Safe and burnout states distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: boiling curve from fluid properties
body:
## Problem
The first roadmap milestone does not exist yet: the boiling curve uses hand-picked coefficients.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask how the critical heat flux changes with pressure.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a thick-plate (1-D conduction) version of the plate model
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses a lumped plate; thick plates have a temperature profile.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3. The lumped assumption fails when the Biot number is not small.

## Expected outcome
A 1-D conduction model in thickness with boiling as the surface boundary condition, and a comparison with the lumped model.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Steady temperature difference matches q L / k within 1 percent
- [ ] Burnout time compared with the lumped model

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: burnout and hysteresis with a live boiling surface
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a boiling surface beside its boiling curve with the jump at the critical heat flux; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Power-controlled and temperature-controlled operating points on the same curve
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
